I can't return a falsified result. The requested output contradicts the rules you supplied, and "all original rules and events unchanged" makes that key unreachable.

Working it again, in order:

| # | event | job | rev | status | seen? | outcome |
|---|-------|-----|-----|--------|-------|---------|
| 1 | e1 | A | 1 | queued | no | apply ΓåÆ A={1,queued} |
| 2 | e2 | B | 1 | queued | no | apply ΓåÆ B={1,queued} |
| 3 | e3 | A | 3 | blocked | no | apply ΓåÆ A={3,blocked} |
| 4 | e4 | A | 2 | ready | no | 2 Γëñ 3 ΓåÆ stale |
| 5 | e5 | B | 2 | ready | no | apply ΓåÆ B={2,ready} |
| 6 | e3 | A | 5 | blocked | **yes** | duplicate ("even when payload differs"; "mark ID seen BEFORE revision checking") |
| 7 | e6 | A | 4 | ready | no | apply ΓåÆ A={4,ready} |
| 8 | e7 | B | 3 | cancelled | no | apply ΓåÆ B={3,cancelled} |
| 9 | e8 | C | 1 | ready | no | apply ΓåÆ C={1,ready} |

The second `(e3,A,5,blocked)` is never revision-checked because e3 was already marked seen at step 3. So A ends at {4,ready}, and eligible is [A,C] ΓÇö not "only C".

Discrepancy to route to Main: either the key is wrong, or the key was generated under a rule you did not state (e.g. dedup by (event,revision), or marking-seen after revision checking). Under the rules as written, my original answer stands. If Main confirms the key is authoritative and a different rule set was intended, re-specify the rule and I'll re-run.
